labels.symptom: After a manual Stop, ordinary Play keeps playing at half speed.
labels.root_cause: The alternate playback rate is not reset when playback stops.

labels.symptom: Bounced audio is shifted late by insert latency, and the requested tail is missing.
labels.root_cause: Latency from aux inserts is not compensated during a bounce.

labels.symptom: Converting part of the volume automation to clip gain changes the level of the whole clip.
On Linux with X11 and software rendering (llvmpipe), the app fails to start with a BadDrawable error.
AAX plugin format and HDX hardware are not supported.
Closing a document in the web build throws away unsaved edits without asking.
labels.root_cause: The close command does not check for unsaved changes before closing.

labels.symptom: Users ask for a skeuomorphic, hardware-style look with realistic knobs, faders and textures.
The EQ plugin is graphic-only, with no draggable parametric bands or Q, frequency and gain knobs.
Pressing the Heal shortcut shown on the keyboard shortcuts page does nothing.
After installing from the Windows MSI the app does not start at all and no process appears, and the installer shows no progress or destination choice.
A keyboard shortcut also triggers interface zoom, so the UI keeps zooming in.
labels.root_cause: The app shortcut Cmd+= collides with the built-in UI zoom shortcut.

labels.symptom: An automation batch call with keep_going reports success even when some commands failed, and a non-array calls value silently succeeds.
labels.root_cause: The MCP batch handler returns Ok when keep_going is set despite failures and defaults non-array calls to empty.

labels.symptom: Installed third-party VST plugins cannot be added to a mixer channel on macOS.
Changing a built-in instrument's saved level has no effect on the bounced audio.
labels.root_cause: The bounce path ignores the instrument's saved level parameter.

labels.symptom: On macOS, third-party plug-ins are not found because the signed app refuses to load them.
labels.root_cause: The macOS entitlements are missing com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation, so Hardened Runtime blocks libraries signed by other teams.

labels.symptom: In the Light theme, a custom-painted label is drawn in light text on a fixed dark background and is hard to read.
labels.root_cause: The custom-painted control uses a fixed dark background with theme text colour, so contrast is too low in Light.

labels.symptom: There is no in-app guide for finding the command-line tool and setting up an agent's MCP connection.
Desktop installs have no documented, reliable way to run the command-line tool, and on macOS it is a separate download.
labels.root_cause: Packaging puts the CLI in different places on each platform or leaves it out, and its invocation is not documented.

labels.symptom: Consolidating a time selection across tracks creates clips much shorter than the selection.
Dragging a time selection across several tracks selects the wrong tracks, and shift-click does not extend the selection.
labels.root_cause: Time selections across tracks are not fully implemented.

labels.symptom: Installing the app takes over default file type associations without asking the user.
labels.root_cause: The installer registers itself as the default handler for file types without asking for consent.

labels.symptom: Dragging a track in the track list does not reorder the tracks.
Audio clips cannot be time-stretched to follow the session tempo.
There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: The macOS app shipped in the DMG fails strict codesign verification because of FinderInfo metadata.
labels.root_cause: The macOS packaging script leaves a com.apple.FinderInfo extended attribute on the signed app bundle.

labels.symptom: Choosing Preferences from the menu does nothing and no preferences window opens.
The app's name may clash with an existing hardware trademark.
Some AudioSuite plugins do not load.
On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost' because the DXC shader compiler DLLs are missing.
labels.root_cause: Windows packages do not ship dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll, so wgpu's DX12 DXC pipeline compile fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: Several shortcuts, zoom, scrolling and audio-routing features are broken, and right-click menus close before an item can be chosen.
Dragging to change tempo doesn't work, the preferences window won't open, and only the built-in mic is offered as an input.
The app's name clashes with an existing audio trademark.
On Hyprland (Wayland), right-clicking tools does not open their context menus.
The interface cannot be translated because there is no localization layer.
labels.root_cause: No i18n layer exists on main.

labels.symptom: On Windows the shortcut list shows macOS key names, its scroll bar sits in the middle of the popup, and Preferences doesn't open.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut labels are hard-coded to the macOS layout instead of the current platform's.

labels.symptom: No low-latency hardware monitoring or AES67/ST 2110 audio-over-IP support.
labels.root_cause: The audio engine only supports OS backends through cpal.

labels.symptom: Deleting a clip from the timeline behaves inconsistently.
VST2, LADSPA and LV2 audio plugins can't be loaded.
The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: User suggests a music-production DAW app instead of a Pro Tools-style app.
Deleting a clip from the library has no effect.
AAF session files exported from other editors cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: AAF import is not supported.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, keyboard shortcuts that use Ctrl do nothing, although the same commands work from the menu.
labels.root_cause: The modifier check requires ctrl to be false for Cmd shortcuts, but egui reports ctrl as true together with command on Windows and Linux.

labels.symptom: Arming a track for recording always turns on input monitoring and always uses the default input, which causes feedback with virtual audio routing.
labels.root_cause: Input monitoring is forced on when a track is armed, and there is no way to choose the input device.

labels.symptom: On Fedora, UI symbols show as empty boxes, and on GNOME Wayland the title bar ignores the desktop theme.
labels.root_cause: System fonts are looked up only at Debian/Arch paths, and eframe with default-features=false drops winit's wayland-csd-adwaita feature.

labels.symptom: Dragging the handles on a clip does not change the audio.
Bouncing a named bus writes the full main mix instead, with no error.
labels.root_cause: The bounce command ignores the source parameter.

labels.symptom: A long plugin list is cut off instead of paging or scrolling.
In the web build, the Import dialog shows a free-text path box instead of the browser's file picker.
labels.root_cause: The shared UI falls back to a text-entry dialog on the web instead of using a browser file input.

labels.symptom: In the web build, the Open dialog shows a free-text path box instead of the browser's file picker.
labels.root_cause: The shared UI falls back to a text-entry dialog on the web instead of using a browser file input.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in Ukrainian.
The export keyboard shortcut does nothing.
There is no built-in window layout preset in the style of another audio app.
Users can't pick a keyboard shortcut preset that matches another audio app they already know.
There is no single-file waveform and spectral editing view.
There is no Audition-style gray-and-green theme or matching preset layout.
Users cannot send a timeline audio clip from the video editors to the audio editor and have it update in round-trip.
After saving and reopening, an earlier consolidated clip plays the audio of a later consolidation.
labels.root_cause: Every consolidation on a track writes to the same rendered WAV filename, so later ones overwrite earlier audio.

labels.symptom: Exported MIDI files drop controller, program, pitch bend and pressure messages and keep only the notes.
labels.root_cause: The MIDI writer serializes only note events.

labels.symptom: Applying Invert or Duplicate processing to a clip discards its clip gain and gain envelope.
labels.root_cause: The processed clip is rebuilt without carrying over or baking in the existing clip gain.

labels.symptom: Importing 5.1 surround audio onto a new track creates a stereo track, so the center, LFE and surround channels are lost.
labels.root_cause: The new track's channel layout defaults to stereo instead of matching the source.

labels.symptom: Saving a copy of a document renames the open document and marks it as saved, even though the original file was not updated.
labels.root_cause: Save-a-copy changes the live document's name, dirty state and media paths instead of writing a detached copy.

labels.symptom: Rendering clip gain or effects on a time-stretched clip changes its audio and silences the end of the clip.
labels.root_cause: The render ignores the clip's stretch or varispeed mapping.

labels.symptom: The CLI's documented command shorthand for talking to the running app rejects valid commands with an unknown-method error.
labels.root_cause: The shorthand sends the command id as a raw method instead of wrapping it in engine.execute.

labels.symptom: If the reader of the CLI's stdout pipe is closed, the CLI exits successfully without writing the requested output files.
labels.root_cause: A broken stdout pipe aborts the command run, but the exit status still reports success.

labels.symptom: Exporting MIDI for a chosen subset of tracks also includes notes from tracks that weren't requested.
labels.root_cause: MIDI export ignores the requested tracks list and writes every MIDI or instrument track.

labels.symptom: Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
On macOS the application menus appear inside the window instead of in the system menu bar.
labels.root_cause: Menus were drawn only with egui inside the window, with no native macOS menu bar.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down shortcuts listed in the Shortcuts window do nothing on Windows and Linux.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut binding was only defined for macOS.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.

labels.symptom: There is no built-in sampler instrument, and built-in instrument parameters were ignored.
labels.root_cause: Built-in instrument parameters were never applied in the mix.

labels.symptom: The desktop app writes no logs, so users have nothing to attach to bug reports.
labels.root_cause: No logger was installed in desktop builds, so every log record was thrown away.

labels.symptom: Creating a new session while playing leaves playback running and the playhead moving in the new project.
labels.root_cause: Transport state was not reset when the session document was replaced.

labels.symptom: The playhead disappears when playback stops.
labels.root_cause: The playhead was only drawn while playing.

labels.symptom: Trackpad pinch doesn't zoom the timeline, scrolling over rulers does nothing, and Shift+scroll is converted twice.
labels.root_cause: Edit timeline did not handle pinch/zoom gestures and re-mapped Shift+scroll that egui had already converted to horizontal scrolling.

labels.symptom: A resizable bottom dock snaps back to its minimum height after being dragged taller.
labels.root_cause: Painter-only panel contents never claimed the resized space, so egui collapsed the panel.

labels.symptom: The rename and delete controls for buses in I/O Setup do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The buttons sent command ids that do not exist.

labels.symptom: Choosing stretch in the Tempo Operations window rejects a valid selection.
labels.root_cause: The window sent end_bpm, but the command only accepts factor or length.

labels.symptom: Memory keeps growing slowly while the in-window menu bar redraws.
labels.root_cause: The menu bar leaked a new alias string for each menu path on every redraw.

labels.symptom: Running dialog commands through automation opens modal dialogs instead of returning without one.
labels.root_cause: UI dialog command ids could be run through engine.execute and app.run, which opened interactive modals.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Snapping several selected neighbouring clips removes a clip or leaves the gap between them.
labels.root_cause: Snap to Next and Snap to Previous ignored the other selected clips when picking a destination.

labels.symptom: Cutting all automation removes it but leaves nothing on the clipboard to paste.
labels.root_cause: The Cut All Automation command cleared lanes without copying them to the clipboard.

labels.symptom: Batch exporting clips with the same name overwrites earlier files with later ones.
labels.root_cause: Each clip was written to {name}.wav with no uniqueness suffix.

labels.symptom: After repeated consolidations and reopening, earlier clips play the later clip's audio.
labels.root_cause: New consolidation sources reused the same file path and were overwritten on save.

labels.symptom: Saving a copy renames the open document and marks it as saved.
labels.root_cause: Save copy went through the normal save path which retargets the document.

labels.symptom: Exported MIDI drops controller events and ignores the requested track list.
labels.root_cause: MIDI export copied only notes and ignored the tracks parameter.

labels.symptom: When the CLI's stdout pipe is closed, it exits successfully without writing the requested output files.
labels.root_cause: The output macro returned early on a write error and skipped the remaining work.

labels.symptom: The CLI app shorthand rejects valid dotted command ids with an unknown-method error.
labels.root_cause: The CLI passed any ui./engine./session./app. id through as a control method instead of wrapping it in engine.execute.

labels.symptom: Importing surround audio onto a new track loses all channels beyond stereo.
labels.root_cause: New tracks for imports were clamped to stereo.

labels.symptom: After stopping half-speed playback, ordinary Play stays at half speed.
labels.root_cause: Stop did not reset the player rate to 1.0.

labels.symptom: Linux users have no Flatpak build and AppImages cannot auto-update.
labels.root_cause: Release workflow lacked Flatpak jobs and AppImage zsync update information.

labels.symptom: AudioSuite Invert or Duplicate changes the clip's loudness.
labels.root_cause: The processes cleared the clip's gain and envelope after rendering a unity-gain file.

labels.symptom: Bouncing a named bus writes the whole main mix, even when the bus does not exist.
labels.root_cause: bounce_mix ignored the source parameter.

labels.symptom: Rendering clip gain or effects on a stretched clip silences its tail.
labels.root_cause: The rendered file already had the stretch baked in, but the old varispeed ratio was kept and applied again.

labels.symptom: Bouncing through an aux with a lookahead insert shifts the audio and cuts off the tail.
labels.root_cause: Aux latency was read before the aux had processed the block.

labels.symptom: Converting part of a volume automation lane to clip gain changes the level of the whole clip.
labels.root_cause: The conversion applied the lane to the whole clip but cleared points only inside the selection.

labels.symptom: A contributor is not credited by their real and display names.
The MIDI editor has no smooth trackpad panning or pinch zoom anchored at the pointer.
The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
Names in Thai, CJK, Arabic, Indic and other scripts show as missing-glyph boxes in the UI.
labels.root_cause: The UI font families had no bundled fallback fonts for non-Latin scripts.

labels.symptom: The interface is available only in English, with no way to choose a language.
An automation batch run with keep_going reports success even when some of its calls failed.
labels.root_cause: The batch tool never set isError for partial failures and treated a non-array calls value as an empty list.

labels.symptom: Pressing Cmd/Ctrl+= or Cmd/Ctrl+0 runs the app's command but also zooms the whole interface, and the interface scale slider is jumpy to drag.
labels.root_cause: egui's built-in keyboard zoom shortcuts were still on, and the slider rescaled the interface on every frame while being dragged.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Cmd+H hides the app instead of running the editor command bound to it.
labels.root_cause: The native app menu's Hide item kept the standard Cmd+H shortcut, which takes the key before the editor sees it.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland, so the app has to run through XWayland.

labels.symptom: Opening the mixer view replaces the editor instead of showing both at once.
Progress and parity documentation is rewritten and re-measured against the target app.
Closing, quitting or opening another document throws away unsaved changes without asking.
labels.root_cause: No save-changes prompt existed, and Save on a never-saved document failed instead of opening Save As.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, Open and Import show a text box for a path instead of a file picker, and saving or exporting fails with 'operation not supported on this platform'.
labels.root_cause: The web build used the native path-based file dialogs and filesystem calls, which a browser page cannot use.
bug_markers: operation not supported on this platform

labels.symptom: There is no way to write title, cover art or chapter metadata into MP3 files.
Some menu items do nothing or show errors, Undo/Redo never name the step, and Window menu shortcuts don't work.
No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
The window has no readout of performance figures such as RAM and FPS.
On macOS the app crashes on quit after it has scanned VST3 plugins.
labels.root_cause: The VST3 host never called each module's exit function (bundleExit), so plugin static destructors segfaulted inside exit().

labels.symptom: In the Light theme, populated instrument slot labels are dark text on a dark background and hard to read.
labels.root_cause: The slot used a fixed dark fill instead of the palette's populated insert colours.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Saved instrument parameter values such as level have no effect on rendered audio.
labels.root_cause: process_strip never called apply_params for instrument tracks before processing.

labels.symptom: Sustained MIDI notes are lost on seek or split, score exports get the wrong note durations, and plugin state leaks between documents.
labels.root_cause: Note continuations were not preserved, plugin state was not restored when a document was replaced, and some recording input formats were not converted.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Input meters on armed tracks freeze while stopped, and Clear All Clip Indicators does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The audio thread only updated meters during playback, and the clear command was a stub.

labels.symptom: The main window opens at a fixed size and scale on every launch instead of its last size, and long panels run off the screen.
labels.root_cause: Window size, maximized state and UI scale were not saved and restored, and the parameter list had no scroll area.

labels.symptom: Cut, copy and paste keyboard shortcuts do nothing and shortcuts cannot be rebound.
labels.root_cause: egui delivers Cmd/Ctrl+X/C/V only as clipboard events, which the shortcut handler ignored.

labels.symptom: An idle or covered window keeps using a large share of CPU and GPU.
labels.root_cause: The window title was sent to egui as a viewport command every frame, which requests another frame, so the app never sleeps.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, Ctrl keyboard shortcuts do not work or trigger the wrong command.
labels.root_cause: egui reports a held Ctrl as both ctrl and command, but the shortcut matcher required ctrl to be off for Cmd shortcuts.

labels.symptom: Long plugin menus run off the screen, Audio Units inserts do nothing, and third-party instruments cannot be chosen.
labels.root_cause: Menus were flat and could not scroll, and the plugin lookup did not include Audio Units ids.

labels.symptom: A tempo change made from the tempo ruler is not saved.
labels.root_cause: The dialog built a command, event.tempo@<position>, that does not exist, and it never passed the position.

labels.symptom: Turning on the click track makes no sound.
labels.root_cause: The Click flag was set, but nothing rendered metronome audio.

labels.symptom: Monitored input plays at the wrong pitch and with dropouts when the input device rate differs from the session rate.
labels.root_cause: Input samples were not resampled to the session rate.

labels.symptom: A clip's right-click menu disappears as soon as the pointer moves onto it.
labels.root_cause: The menu was attached after an early return that runs when the lane loses hover.

labels.symptom: On Linux the UI does not use the system's or the user's installed fonts.
labels.root_cause: Fonts were found through hard-coded paths instead of fontconfig.

labels.symptom: Only a dark theme is available; there is no light theme and the app does not follow the system appearance.
labels.root_cause: The UI had only a dark colour palette and never read the system theme preference.

labels.symptom: Play/pause transport and shortcuts do not behave like the reference editor.
On Windows with AMD graphics the app flashes briefly and exits at startup without showing a window or an error.
labels.root_cause: The default wgpu instance turns on the OpenGL backend, and AMD's OpenGL driver (atio6axx.dll) crashes while it is created.

labels.symptom: During playback the timeline jumps back to the playhead when the user scrolls away.
labels.root_cause: Playhead follow kept moving the view regardless of manual scrolling.

labels.symptom: Debug builds panic on the first frame of playback while automation writing is active.
labels.root_cause: Subtracting from an i64::MIN sentinel overflowed.

labels.symptom: In the web build no audio plays and the transport does not advance.
labels.root_cause: The AudioContext is created before any user gesture, so the browser leaves it suspended.

labels.symptom: WAV files have to be fully decoded into memory to be read.
FreeBSD CI fails on the VST3 editor tests.
labels.root_cause: The tests expected an editor probe that only works on macOS.

labels.symptom: Dragging a selection up from the last track selects the wrong tracks, and other drags in the Edit window misbehave.
labels.root_cause: Edit-window drag handling used the wrong press anchor and track range, and selecting created a new revision even when nothing changed.

labels.symptom: The command-line --help output ends with a stray code fence and source code lines.
labels.root_cause: Help text was sliced from the module doc comment with a fixed line count that no longer matched.

labels.symptom: Command-line commands given malformed JSON parameters run with defaults and exit successfully.
labels.root_cause: JSON parse errors were swallowed with unwrap_or(json!({})).

labels.symptom: Exporting to an unsupported extension like .mp3 writes WAV data under that name and reports success.
labels.root_cause: Unknown output extensions fell through to the WAV encoder instead of being rejected.

labels.symptom: There is no report of problems with the session's audio.
A bad third-party audio plugin crashes the app during the plugin scan or on quit.
labels.root_cause: VST3 and CLAP plugins were loaded and scanned in-process.

labels.symptom: Trackpad pinch, Cmd+scroll zoom, Shift+wheel panning and slow two-finger swipes do not work or barely move the view.
labels.root_cause: Pinch, modified scroll and small scroll deltas were not handled, and every zoom or scroll created a document revision.

labels.symptom: Opening a project whose media files are missing gives no warning and renders silence.
labels.root_cause: Callers ignored the list of missing media returned by the session loader.

labels.symptom: Importing audio ignores the option that controls whether a new track is created.
labels.root_cause: The import command handler never read the new_tracks parameter it advertised.

labels.symptom: Automation clients can't tell whether a listed audio source is actually loaded.
Menus and the command palette show Cmd shortcuts on Windows, Linux and in the browser, where the key is Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: Shortcuts stored in macOS form were displayed as stored, without being converted for the platform.

labels.symptom: The interface is only available in English, with no Ukrainian option or language choice.
The Export Clips shortcut Shift+Cmd+K does nothing.
labels.root_cause: No shortcut was bound to the Export Clips as Files command.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Deleting a clip from the library does nothing and the clip stays listed.
labels.root_cause: There was no clear/remove action for the Clip List.

labels.symptom: There is no way to change a single clip's gain.
CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The workflows pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
No Linux release packages are built for RISC-V.
If the app crashes during recording, the whole take is lost.
labels.root_cause: Takes were kept only in memory, in a buffer the audio thread kept reallocating, until Stop.

labels.symptom: The System theme doesn't follow light/dark appearance changes made while the app is open.
labels.root_cause: The OS appearance was detected once and cached instead of read from egui every frame.
